title: Dune Part 1 - Character Anchor Embeddings & Scene Turn Boundary Ground Truth

Chani.role: Fremen warrior / Paul's prophetic love interest / Opening narrator

primary_seed_anchor.label: Opening Narration - Desert Beauty & Spice
primary_seed_anchor.transcript: My planet Arrakis is so beautiful when the sun is low. Rolling over the sands... you can see spice in the air.
primary_seed_anchor.rationale: Opening soliloquy over sweeping Arrakis dunes with minimal ambient score, close-mic vocal presence, and zero cross-talk. High SNR (~19.9 dB).

secondary_anchors.label: Crysknife Presentation to Paul
secondary_anchors.transcript: I don't believe you're the Lisan al-Gaib. But I want you to die with honour. This crysknife was given to me by my great aunt. It's made from a tooth of Shai-Hulud. The great sandworm. This will be a great honour, for you to die holding it.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Quiet, reverent dialogue in rock shelter handing Paul her aunt's crysknife before the Jamis duel. Intimate whispered vocal delivery.

secondary_anchors.label: Desert Prophetic Vision
secondary_anchors.transcript: A friend will help you. Follow the friend. You have much to learn. And I will show you the ways of the desert.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Soft, clear poetic monologue in Paul's vision ('A friend will help you. Follow the friend...').

secondary_anchors.label: Final Movie Dialogue
secondary_anchors.transcript: This is only the beginning.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Final line of film ('This is only the beginning.') turning toward camera.

primary_seed_anchor.label: Ecological Station - Landsraad Challenge to Kynes
primary_seed_anchor.transcript: You know what the Great Houses fear most, Dr Kynes? Exactly what has happened to us here. The Sardaukar coming and picking them off one by one. Only together can they stand a chance against the Imperium. Would you bear witness? Testify that the Emperor has moved against us here?
primary_seed_anchor.rationale: Clear, steady, articulate acoustic monologue explaining political strategy to Kynes. Controlled room acoustic, low noise floor, excellent SNR (~25.9 dB).

secondary_anchors.label: Desert Climax - Road into the Desert Speech to Stilgar
secondary_anchors.transcript: The Emperor sent us to this place. And my father came, not for spice, not for the riches, but for the strength of your people. My road leads into the desert. I can see it. If you'll have us, we will come.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Resolute, mature vocal declaration to Stilgar and Sietch Tabr after defeating Jamis. High vocal authority.

secondary_anchors.label: Caladan Breakfast Inquiry
secondary_anchors.transcript: Why do we have to go through all this when it's already been decided?
secondary_anchors.rationale: Clean, crisp morning conversational register with Lady Jessica in dining hall.

secondary_anchors.label: Desert Tent Spice Vision Outburst
secondary_anchors.transcript: I see a holy war spreading across the universe like unquenchable fire. A warrior religion that waves the Atreides banner in my father's name.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Intense, emotive, high-salience vocal performance projecting panic over the future galactic jihad.

Lady_Jessica.role: Bene Gesserit sister / Leto's concubine / Paul's mother

primary_seed_anchor.label: Arrakeen Residency - Interrogation of Shadout Mapes
primary_seed_anchor.transcript: I know many things. I know that you have a weapon concealed in your bodice. If you mean to harm me, I must warn you, whatever you're hiding, it won't be enough.
primary_seed_anchor.rationale: Calm, icy, commanding Bene Gesserit vocal timbre identifying Mapes' concealed crysknife. High SNR (~26.4 dB), ultra-clean interior acoustic.

secondary_anchors.label: Caladan Breakfast - Command to Use the Voice
secondary_anchors.transcript: If you want it, make me give it to you. Use the Voice.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Authoritative maternal instructional tone ('If you want it, make me give it to you. Use the Voice.'). High SNR (~30.0 dB).

secondary_anchors.label: Gom Jabbar Exterior - Litany Against Fear (Part 1)
secondary_anchors.transcript: I must not fear. I must not fear. Fear is the mind-killer. Fear is the little death that brings obliteration. And I'll face my fear and I'll permit it to pass over me and through me.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Whispered, trembling, highly distinctive rhythmic recitation of the Litany outside the testing chamber.

secondary_anchors.label: Caladan Grounds - Explanation of Bene Gesserit Politics
secondary_anchors.transcript: The Bene Gesserit serve as powerful partners to the Great Houses, but there's more to it. You steer the politics of the Imperium from the shadows.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Thoughtful, hushed explanation of secret breeding and political steering.

Duke_Leto_Atreides.role: Head of House Atreides / Duke of Caladan & Arrakis

primary_seed_anchor.label: Arrakis Council - Fief Agreement with Stilgar
primary_seed_anchor.transcript: Gurney, just... just a moment. The Emperor has given me Arrakis as my fief to rule and protect. I cannot promise not to travel into the desert if duty compels me. But your sietches will be yours forever. And you will never be hunted while I govern here.
primary_seed_anchor.rationale: Diplomatic, stately, baritone speech granting eternal sovereignty to Fremen sietches. Outstanding SNR (~35.9 dB), perfectly balanced room resonance.

secondary_anchors.label: Caladan Graveyard - Cultivating Desert Power
secondary_anchors.transcript: No. By making an alliance with the Fremen. That's what I've sent Duncan Idaho to arrange. Here on Caladan, we've ruled by air power and sea power. On Arrakis, we need to cultivate desert power.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Intimate, resolute father-son guidance regarding Fremen alliance. Pristine SNR (~30.0 dB) in quiet graveyard.

secondary_anchors.label: Caladan Graveyard - Leadership & Fatherhood
secondary_anchors.transcript: Your grandfather said, "A great man doesn't seek to lead. He's called to it, and he answers." And if your answer is no... you'll still be the only thing I ever needed you to be... my son. I found my own way to it. Maybe you'll find yours. In their memory... give it a try.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Deep emotional tenderness ('A great man doesn't seek to lead... my son').

secondary_anchors.label: Caladan Ceremony of Change - Acceptance Declaration
secondary_anchors.transcript: We are House Atreides. There is no call we do not answer, there is no faith that we betray. The Emperor asks us to bring peace to Arrakis. House Atreides accepts.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Formal military/state proclamation accepting stewardship of Arrakis.

Baron_Vladimir_Harkonnen.role: Ruler of House Harkonnen / Arch-nemesis of House Atreides

primary_seed_anchor.label: Giedi Prime Mud Bath - 'My desert. My Arrakis. My Dune.'
primary_seed_anchor.transcript: I said I would not harm them. And I shall not. But Arrakis is Arrakis. And the desert takes the weak. My desert. My Arrakis. My Dune.
primary_seed_anchor.rationale: Iconic, rumbling, ultra-deep sub-bass vocal timbre. Zero music mask, stark sub-harmonic chest resonance, high SNR (~22.3 dB).

secondary_anchors.label: Giedi Prime - Word of Honour to Reverend Mother
secondary_anchors.transcript: House Harkonnen would never dream of violating the sanctity of your order. I give you my word. We will not harm them.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Sinuous, deceitful political vow with distinctive low vocal fry.

secondary_anchors.label: Floating Bath to Rabban - Demand for Spice Income ('Squeeze hard')
secondary_anchors.transcript: So, it's done. Finally. Send word to Giedi Prime to begin selling our spice reserves. But slowly. We don't want the price to fall. You have no idea how much it cost me to bring such a force to bear here. Now I only have one requirement. Income. So, squeeze, Rabban. Squeeze hard.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Gravelly, wheezing baritone commanding economic oppression after surviving poison gas.

secondary_anchors.label: Arrakeen Palace to Paralyzed Leto - Fall of House Atreides
secondary_anchors.transcript: For hundreds of years, we've traded blood for blood. But no more. Your son is dead. Your concubine is dead. Tonight the House of Atreides falls. And your bloodline ends forever.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Mocking, triumphalist taunt standing over the fallen Duke.

Reverend_Mother_Gaius_Helen_Mohiam.role: Bene Gesserit Truthsayer to the Padishah Emperor

primary_seed_anchor.label: Gom Jabbar Chamber - The Poison Needle Rule
primary_seed_anchor.transcript: I hold at your neck the Gom Jabbar. A poison needle. Instant death. The test is simple. Remove your hand from the box and you die.
primary_seed_anchor.rationale: Chilling, razor-sharp diction explaining the Gom Jabbar test. Absolute quiet room, phenomenal SNR (~33.5 dB), dry direct vocal presence.

secondary_anchors.label: Gom Jabbar Chamber - Sifting Sand / Humanity Test
secondary_anchors.transcript: Like sifting sand through a screen, we sift people. If you had been unable to control your impulses, like an animal, we could not let you live. You inherit too much power.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Philosophical explanation of Bene Gesserit natural selection ('we sift people'). High SNR (~24.1 dB).

secondary_anchors.label: Caladan Ship Landing - Reprimand of Lady Jessica
secondary_anchors.transcript: You chose to train him in the Way, in defiance of our rule. He wields our power. He had to be tested to the limits. So much potential, wasted in a male. You were told to bear only daughters. But you, in your pride, thought you could produce the Kwisatz Haderach.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Harsh, imperious condemnation of Jessica's pride in breeding a son.

secondary_anchors.label: Giedi Prime - Protection of Jessica and Paul
secondary_anchors.transcript: On that matter, Duke Leto Atreides means nothing to our order. But his wife is under our protection and by extension, her son. Allow them the dignity of exile.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Stern decree to Baron Harkonnen enforcing Bene Gesserit covenant.

Stilgar.role: Naib of Sietch Tabr / Fremen leader

primary_seed_anchor.label: Arrakis Council - Fremen Desert Boundary Demand
primary_seed_anchor.transcript: I ask for this. Do not seek our sietches. Do not trespass in our lands. The desert was ours long before you came. So, come and dig your spice, but when you have it, go back to this side of the Shield Wall and leave the desert to the Fremen.
primary_seed_anchor.rationale: Gravelly, earthy, intense Fremen vocal timbre warning the Outworlders to stay behind the Shield Wall. Outstanding SNR (~34.2 dB).

secondary_anchors.label: Desert Rock Confrontation - Praise of the Brave Crossing
secondary_anchors.transcript: That was a brave crossing they made in the path of Shai-Hulud. He does not speak or act like a weakling. Nor did his father.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Deep authoritative Fremen dialect acknowledging Paul and Leto's courage to Jamis. High SNR (~29.5 dB).

secondary_anchors.label: Desert Rock Confrontation - Sanctuary Verdict
secondary_anchors.transcript: The boy is young. He can learn our ways. He may have sanctuary. But the woman is untrained... and too old to learn.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Harsh desert pragmatism judging Paul vs Jessica.

secondary_anchors.label: Post-Duel - Acceptance of Paul into Sietch Tabr
secondary_anchors.transcript: You're one of us now. A life for a life. Come with us to Sietch Tabr.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Ceremonial Fremen decree ('A life for a life. Come with us to Sietch Tabr.').

Gurney_Halleck.role: Warmaster of House Atreides / Paul's combat trainer

primary_seed_anchor.label: Shield Training Room - Harkonnen Brutality Monologue
primary_seed_anchor.transcript: For 80 years, Arrakis belonged to House Harkonnen. 80 years of owning the spice fields. Can you imagine the wealth? Your eyes. I need to see it in your eyes. You never met Harkonnens before, I have. They're not human, they're brutal! You have to be ready.
primary_seed_anchor.rationale: Passionate, gritty, battle-scarred baritone lecturing Paul on Harkonnen violence. Phenomenal SNR (~32.3 dB), dry acoustic, powerful vocal projection.

secondary_anchors.label: Shield Training Room - Gravity of Situation
secondary_anchors.transcript: You don't get it, do you? You don't really understand the grave nature of what's happening to us.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Stern, urgent wake-up call to Paul ('You don't get it, do you?'). SNR (~32.2 dB).

secondary_anchors.label: Shield Training Room - Necessity Over Mood
secondary_anchors.transcript: What's mood to do with it? You fight when the necessity arises, no matter the mood. Now fight!
secondary_anchors.rationale: Classic combat instruction ('What's mood to do with it? You fight when the necessity arises...').

secondary_anchors.label: Shield Training Room Entrance
secondary_anchors.transcript: Are you the new Weapons Master? With Duncan Idaho gone, I must make do as best I can. Choose your blade.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Gruff, wry dialogue challenging Paul to choose his blade.

Duncan_Idaho.role: Swordmaster of the Ginaz / Advance scout to the Fremen

primary_seed_anchor.label: Arrakis Council Room - Report on Fremen Lethality
primary_seed_anchor.transcript: The Fremen watched me search for them for days. I never saw them. Finally, they sent a warrior out to kill me. And I gotta tell you, I have never come so close to dying. There's no finer fighter in the Imperium. They fight like demons.
primary_seed_anchor.rationale: Warm, rugged, dynamic storytelling tone reporting on four weeks with the Fremen. Phenomenal acoustic clarity, SNR (~34.4 dB).

secondary_anchors.label: Arrakis Council Room - Introduction of Stilgar
secondary_anchors.transcript: For four weeks, I lived with the Fremen. Hidden in the desert, in a community called a sietch. Stilgar, the leader of that sietch, has come with me to meet you, sire.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Formal military intelligence report to Duke Leto. Pristine SNR (~30.4 dB).

secondary_anchors.label: Arrakis Council Room - Acceptance of Stilgar's Moisture
secondary_anchors.transcript: Thank you, Stilgar, for the gift of your body's moisture. We accept it in the spirit in which it was given.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Calm, diplomatic explanation preventing bloodshed over Fremen spitting custom. SNR (~29.1 dB).

secondary_anchors.label: Arrakis Ornithopter - Reverence for the Desert
secondary_anchors.transcript: I do. They're fierce but loyal. They're attuned to the desert. Part of it. It's part of them. You wait till you see it. It's beautiful out there.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Affectionate, awe-struck reflection on Fremen harmony with Arrakis. SNR (~27.6 dB).

secondary_anchors.label: Caladan Hangar - Wisdom on Dreams and Action
secondary_anchors.transcript: That's why you want to come with me. Listen. Dreams make good stories, but everything important happens when we're awake. 'Cause that's when we make things happen. Look at you. Put on some muscle?
secondary_anchors.rationale: Big-brother mentoring Paul before departure ('Dreams make good stories... Put on some muscle?').

Thufir_Hawat.role: Master of Assassins / Mentat of House Atreides

primary_seed_anchor.label: Arrakis Council Room - Harkonnen Spice Ledger Analysis
primary_seed_anchor.transcript: I secured a copy of the Harkonnens' account books. The Harkonnens were taking 10 billion solaris out of here every year.
primary_seed_anchor.rationale: Analytical, rhythmic, Mentat computational cadence breaking down 10 billion solaris spice extraction. Excellent room clarity, SNR (~23.1 dB).

secondary_anchors.label: Residency - Resignation Offer to Duke Leto
secondary_anchors.transcript: Sire, I failed you today. There's no excuse. You have my resignation.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Grave, sorrowful, honourable delivery after hunter-seeker breach. SNR (~17.9 dB).

secondary_anchors.label: Caladan Ceremony - Guild Navigator Cost Calculation
secondary_anchors.transcript: Three Guild Navigators. A total of 1.46 million, 62 solaris, round trip.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Rapid computational trances ('Three Guild Navigators. A total of 1.46 million, 62 solaris...').

secondary_anchors.label: Arrakis Council - Briefing on Dr. Liet Kynes
secondary_anchors.transcript: Dr Liet Kynes. Imperial Ecologist. Been here 20 years. Eccentric, from what I'm told.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Terse intelligence summary of the Imperial Ecologist.

Herald_of_the_Change.role: Padishah Imperial Emissary / Master of Ceremonies

primary_seed_anchor.label: Caladan Ceremony of the Change - Witness Invocation
primary_seed_anchor.transcript: We are witnessed by members of the Imperial Court, representatives of the Spacing Guild and a sister of the Bene Gesserit. The Emperor has spoken.
primary_seed_anchor.rationale: Magnificent, theatrical, boomingly resonant heraldic cadence witnessed by Imperial Court and Spacing Guild. High acoustic clarity, SNR (~22.7 dB).

secondary_anchors.label: Caladan Ceremony of the Change - Imperial Mandate & Challenge
secondary_anchors.transcript: "House Atreides shall immediately take control of Arrakis and serve as its steward." Do you accept?
secondary_anchors.rationale: Imperial decree transfer of Arrakis to House Atreides ('Do you accept?'). SNR (~19.2 dB).

secondary_anchors.label: Caladan Ceremony of the Change - Sovereign Title Proclamation
secondary_anchors.transcript: By the grace of Shaddam IV of House Corrino, ascendant to the Golden Lion Throne of Padishah Emperor of the Known Universe, I stand before you as Herald of the Change.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Formal heraldic opening invoking Shaddam IV of House Corrino.

Dr_Wellington_Yueh.role: Suk Doctor of House Atreides (Imperial Conditioning broken)

primary_seed_anchor.label: Arrakeen Palace - Deliverance Demand to Baron Harkonnen
primary_seed_anchor.transcript: I jammed their comms and lowered their shields. I delivered the Duke and his family. The bargain to the letter. And what was I to do for you? Deliver my wife from her agony.
primary_seed_anchor.rationale: Tense, desperate, tragic delivery demanding his wife Wanna's release. High SNR (~23.2 dB), stark interior acoustic.

secondary_anchors.label: Caladan Quarters - Checking Paul's Vitals
secondary_anchors.transcript: Hello, young master. Your mother asked me to check your vitals. What's happening? His heart is strong as ever, my lady.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Gentle, respectful, professional bedside manner before Gom Jabbar test.

secondary_anchors.label: Arrakeen Infirmary - Confession of Betrayal to Leto
secondary_anchors.transcript: I'm sorry, my lord. But I've made a bargain with the Baron. Why? I had no choice. The Harkonnens have my wife, Wanna. They take her apart like a doll. I will buy her freedom. And you are the price.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Tortured, weeping confession explaining Wanna's torture by the Harkonnens.

secondary_anchors.label: Arrakeen Infirmary - Poison Peg Tooth Plan
secondary_anchors.transcript: For Paul. I will do what I can. And you will kill a man for me. I'm going to replace your peg tooth. If you bite down hard, this tooth will crush. Breathe out, and you will fill the air with poison. It will be your last breath. But if you choose your moment well, it will also be the Baron's.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Whispered tactical instructions for assassinating the Baron with cyanide gas.

Dr_Liet_Kynes.role: Imperial Ecologist / Judge of the Change / Fremen leader

primary_seed_anchor.label: Arrakeen Testing Room - Stillsuit Technical Briefing
primary_seed_anchor.transcript: A stillsuit is a high-efficiency filtration system. Even this early in the morning, you wouldn't survive two hours without one of these. It cools the body and recycles the water lost to sweat. Your body's movements provide the power.
primary_seed_anchor.rationale: Clear, precise, scientific expository speech detailing the Fremen filtration system. Outstanding SNR (~25.7 dB), minimal background noise.

secondary_anchors.label: Testing Station - Confronting Paul on Imperial Realities
secondary_anchors.transcript: The Emperor feared the Atreides. He brought you here to kill you. What don't you understand? You're a lost boy hiding in a hole in the ground.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Sharp, piercing critique challenging Paul's ambition for the throne. High SNR (~27.8 dB).

secondary_anchors.label: Arrakeen Testing Room - Suit Water Retention Mechanics
secondary_anchors.transcript: Inside the mask, you'll find a tube to allow you to drink the recycled water. In good working order, your suit won't lose more than a thimbleful of water a day.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Clinical description of thimbleful water loss in desert conditions. SNR (~25.4 dB).

secondary_anchors.label: Testing Station - History of Arrakis Ecology & Spice
secondary_anchors.transcript: Do you know what this place is? It's an old ecological testing station. They were meant to tame the planet. Free the water locked beneath the sands. Arrakis could have been a paradise. The work had begun, but then the spice was discovered. And suddenly no one wanted the desert to go away.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Wistful, tragic recounting of how spice exploitation ruined the greening of Arrakis.

secondary_anchors.label: Desert Dunes - Final Defiance to Sardaukar
secondary_anchors.transcript: I serve only one master. His name is Shai-Hulud.
secondary_anchors.rationale: Solemn, unwavering last words ('I serve only one master. His name is Shai-Hulud.').

turn_boundaries.speaker: Lady Jessica
turn_boundaries.text: It's good you're up early.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Lady Jessica
turn_boundaries.text: Your father wants you in full dress

turn_boundaries.speaker: Lady Jessica
turn_boundaries.text: before the Emperor's Herald arrives.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: Full dress?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: Military?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Lady Jessica
turn_boundaries.text: Ceremonial.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: Why do we have to go through all this

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: when it's already been decided?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Lady Jessica
turn_boundaries.text: Ceremony.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: Thank you.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Lady Jessica
turn_boundaries.text: If you want it, make me give it to you.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Lady Jessica
turn_boundaries.text: Use the Voice.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: Mom, I just woke up.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: Give me the water.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Lady Jessica
turn_boundaries.text: The glass can't hear you. Command me.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides (using The Voice)
turn_boundaries.text: Give me the water.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Lady Jessica
turn_boundaries.text: Almost.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: Almost?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Lady Jessica
turn_boundaries.text: Bene Gesserit skills take years to learn, Paul.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Lady Jessica
turn_boundaries.text: You look tired.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Lady Jessica
turn_boundaries.text: More dreams?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: No.

scene_02_caladan_herald_ceremony.title: Caladan Herald of the Change Ceremony

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duke Leto Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: Smile, Gurney.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Gurney Halleck
turn_boundaries.text: I am smiling.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duke Leto Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: How much will it cost them,

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duke Leto Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: travelling all this way for this formality?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Thufir Hawat
turn_boundaries.text: Three Guild Navigators.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Thufir Hawat
turn_boundaries.text: A total of 1.46 million, 62 solaris, round trip.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Herald of the Change
turn_boundaries.text: By the grace of Shaddam IV of House Corrino, ascendant to the Golden Lion Throne of Padishah Emperor of the Known Universe, I stand before you as Herald of the Change. We are witnessed by members of the Imperial Court, representatives of the Spacing Guild and a sister of the Bene Gesserit. The Emperor has spoken. "House Atreides shall immediately take control of Arrakis and serve as its steward." Do you accept?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duke Leto Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: We are House Atreides. There is no call we do not answer, there is no faith that we betray. The Emperor asks us to bring peace to Arrakis. House Atreides accepts.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Atreides Army Chorus
turn_boundaries.text: Atreides! Atreides! Atreides!

turn_boundaries.speaker: Herald of the Change
turn_boundaries.text: Your seal.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: So, it's done?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Lady Jessica
turn_boundaries.text: It's done.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Gurney Halleck
turn_boundaries.text: Don't stand with your back to the door. How many times do we have to tell you?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: I could tell it was you by your footsteps, Gurney Halleck.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Gurney Halleck
turn_boundaries.text: Someone might imitate my stride.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: I know the difference.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Gurney Halleck
turn_boundaries.text: Are you the new Weapons Master? With Duncan Idaho gone, I must make do as best I can. Choose your blade.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: I've had quite a day, Gurney. Give us a song instead. That's rude.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Gurney Halleck
turn_boundaries.text: Come on. Come on.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: Old man.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Gurney Halleck
turn_boundaries.text: Ah, the slow blade penetrates the shield.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: I guess I'm not in the mood today.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Gurney Halleck / Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: - Mood? - Yeah.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Gurney Halleck
turn_boundaries.text: What's mood to do with it? You fight when the necessity arises, no matter the mood. Now fight! Come on!

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: I have you.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Gurney Halleck
turn_boundaries.text: Aye. But look down, my lord. You'd have joined me in death.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: I see you found the mood.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: Will it be that bad?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Gurney Halleck
turn_boundaries.text: You don't get it, do you? You don't really understand the grave nature of what's happening to us. For 80 years, Arrakis belonged to House Harkonnen. 80 years of owning the spice fields. Can you imagine the wealth? Your eyes. I need to see it in your eyes. You never met Harkonnens before, I have. They're not human, they're brutal! You have to be ready.

scene_04_gom_jabbar.title: Gom Jabbar Scene (Reverend Mother vs Paul vs Jessica)

turn_boundaries.speaker: Lady Jessica
turn_boundaries.text: Paul. Paul, wake up.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: What's wrong?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Lady Jessica
turn_boundaries.text: Get dressed and come with me.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: What is this?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Lady Jessica
turn_boundaries.text: The Reverend Mother Gaius Helen Mohiam is here. She was my teacher at the Bene Gesserit school. She's now Truthsayer to the Emperor himself. She would like to meet you.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: Why?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Lady Jessica
turn_boundaries.text: She wants to know about your dreams.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: How does she know about my dreams? And why is Dr Yueh here?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Lady Jessica
turn_boundaries.text: He only needs a moment.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Dr. Wellington Yueh
turn_boundaries.text: Hello, young master. Your mother asked me to check your vitals.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: What's happening?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Dr. Wellington Yueh
turn_boundaries.text: His heart is strong as ever, my lady.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Lady Jessica
turn_boundaries.text: Paul...

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: Who are you?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Reverend Mother Gaius Helen Mohiam
turn_boundaries.text: Defiance in the eyes. Like his father. Leave us.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Lady Jessica
turn_boundaries.text: You must do everything the Reverend Mother tells you.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: You dismiss my mother in her own house.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Reverend Mother Gaius Helen Mohiam (using The Voice)
turn_boundaries.text: Come here. Kneel.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: How dare you use the Voice on me?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Reverend Mother Gaius Helen Mohiam
turn_boundaries.text: Put your right hand in the box.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Reverend Mother Gaius Helen Mohiam
turn_boundaries.text: Your mother bade you obey me.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Reverend Mother Gaius Helen Mohiam
turn_boundaries.text: I hold at your neck the Gom Jabbar. A poison needle. Instant death. The test is simple. Remove your hand from the box and you die.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: What's in the box?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Reverend Mother Gaius Helen Mohiam
turn_boundaries.text: Pain.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Reverend Mother Gaius Helen Mohiam
turn_boundaries.text: No need to call the guards. Your mother stands behind that door. No one would get past her.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: Why are you doing this?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Reverend Mother Gaius Helen Mohiam
turn_boundaries.text: An animal caught in a trap will gnaw off its own leg to escape. What will you do?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Reverend Mother Gaius Helen Mohiam
turn_boundaries.text: Silence.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Lady Jessica (Hallway - Litany Against Fear)
turn_boundaries.text: I must not fear. I must not fear. Fear is the mind-killer. Fear is the little death that brings obliteration. And I'll face my fear and I'll permit it to pass over me and through me. And when it has gone past... I will turn the inner eye and see its path. And where the fear has gone, there will be nothing. Only I will remain.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Reverend Mother Gaius Helen Mohiam
turn_boundaries.text: Enough.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Reverend Mother Gaius Helen Mohiam
turn_boundaries.text: Like sifting sand through a screen, we sift people. If you had been unable to control your impulses, like an animal, we could not let you live. You inherit too much power.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: What, because I'm a duke's son?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Reverend Mother Gaius Helen Mohiam
turn_boundaries.text: Because you are Jessica's son. You have more than one birthright, boy.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Reverend Mother Gaius Helen Mohiam
turn_boundaries.text: Jessica?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Reverend Mother Gaius Helen Mohiam
turn_boundaries.text: You've been training him in the Way.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Reverend Mother Gaius Helen Mohiam
turn_boundaries.text: Tell me about these dreams.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides / Reverend Mother Mohiam
turn_boundaries.text: - I had one tonight. - What did you see?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: A girl. On Arrakis.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Reverend Mother Gaius Helen Mohiam
turn_boundaries.text: Have you dreamt of her before?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: Many times.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Reverend Mother Gaius Helen Mohiam
turn_boundaries.text: Do you often dream things that happen just as you dreamed them?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: Not exactly.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Reverend Mother Gaius Helen Mohiam
turn_boundaries.text: Goodbye, young human. I hope you live.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Lady Jessica
turn_boundaries.text: Did you have to go that far?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Reverend Mother Gaius Helen Mohiam
turn_boundaries.text: You chose to train him in the Way, in defiance of our rule. He wields our power. He had to be tested to the limits. So much potential, wasted in a male. You were told to bear only daughters. But you, in your pride, thought you could produce the Kwisatz Haderach.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Lady Jessica
turn_boundaries.text: Was I wrong?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Reverend Mother Gaius Helen Mohiam
turn_boundaries.text: You're lucky he didn't die in that room. If he is The One, he has a long way to go. His Sight is barely awakened, and now he goes into the fire. But our plans are measured in centuries. We have other prospects if he fails his promise.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Lady Jessica
turn_boundaries.text: Do you see so little hope?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Reverend Mother Gaius Helen Mohiam
turn_boundaries.text: On Arrakis, we have done all we can for you. A path has been laid. Let's hope he doesn't squander it.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Gurney Halleck
turn_boundaries.text: Your first strategy meeting. Paul Atreides, who catches hunter-seekers in his bare hands like a hero of old.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: Thanks for the humiliation, old man.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Gurney Halleck
turn_boundaries.text: Gotta keep an eye on you.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Atreides Guard Officer
turn_boundaries.text: Attention!

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duke Leto Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: Let's get started. Thufir. Operations.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Thufir Hawat
turn_boundaries.text: I secured a copy of the Harkonnens' account books. The Harkonnens were taking 10 billion solaris out of here every year.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Gurney Halleck (quoting scripture)
turn_boundaries.text: "They shall suck of the abundance of the seas, and the treasure hid in the sand."

turn_boundaries.speaker: Thufir Hawat
turn_boundaries.text: We won't see profits like that for a while. Not with the equipment they left us.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duke Leto Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: How bad is it?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Thufir Hawat
turn_boundaries.text: These are spice silos. We're meant to fill every crate.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: All of them?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Thufir Hawat
turn_boundaries.text: Every 25 standard days. Harkonnen sabotage slows us down.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duke Leto Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: But who's meant to arbitrate? Isn't there a Judge of the Change to oversee the transition? Who did the Emperor appoint?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Thufir Hawat
turn_boundaries.text: Dr Liet Kynes. Imperial Ecologist. Been here 20 years. Eccentric, from what I'm told.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duke Leto Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: I want to see these harvesting fields myself.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Thufir Hawat
turn_boundaries.text: I wouldn't recommend it, my lord.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duke Leto Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: Have this Judge of the Change accompany us. A meeting's long overdue. And we'll get a bit of Imperial protection.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Gurney Halleck
turn_boundaries.text: A hostage?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duke Leto Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: I love it.

scene_06_stilgar_meeting.title: Arrakis Meeting with Stilgar (Water Gift & Sietch Pact)

turn_boundaries.speaker: Guard Attendant
turn_boundaries.text: He's here, my lord.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duncan Idaho
turn_boundaries.text: Take care of them. They are friends. / My boy! / I swear you're getting taller.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Paul Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: Well, you smell much worse.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duncan Idaho
turn_boundaries.text: For four weeks, I lived with the Fremen. Hidden in the desert, in a community called a sietch. Stilgar, the leader of that sietch, has come with me to meet you, sire.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duke Leto Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: This sietch, how is it hidden?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duncan Idaho
turn_boundaries.text: It's underground. Arrakis is filled with caverns.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duke Leto Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: How big was the place?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duncan Idaho
turn_boundaries.text: I'd say 10,000 people. And there are hundreds of sietches. Millions of Fremen.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duke Leto Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: You were right.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Thufir Hawat
turn_boundaries.text: The Harkonnen estimate was 50,000 on the whole planet.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duncan Idaho
turn_boundaries.text: The Fremen watched me search for them for days. I never saw them. Finally, they sent a warrior out to kill me. And I gotta tell you, I have never come so close to dying. There's no finer fighter in the Imperium. They fight like demons.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duke Leto Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: Desert power.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duke Leto Atreides / Duncan Idaho
turn_boundaries.text: - Duncan. Well done. - Thank you, my lord.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Atreides Guard
turn_boundaries.text: Sire. Their leader has a knife he won't surrender, sire.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duncan Idaho
turn_boundaries.text: It's a crysknife. It's sacred to his people.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duke Leto Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: Let him pass.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Gurney Halleck
turn_boundaries.text: Stop there. Hey! Hey!

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duke Leto Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: Stilgar. Welcome. Sir, I respect the personal dignity of any man that respects mine.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duncan Idaho
turn_boundaries.text: Hold.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duncan Idaho
turn_boundaries.text: Thank you, Stilgar, for the gift of your body's moisture. We accept it in the spirit in which it was given.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duke Leto Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: I'm glad you've come. I believe your people and mine have much to offer one another.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Stilgar
turn_boundaries.text: No, no, you are Outworlders. You come here for the spice, you take it, giving nothing in return.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duke Leto Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: That's true.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duke Leto Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: I know you've suffered at the hands of the Harkonnen. Name what you want. If it's in my power to grant, I'll give it and ask for nothing.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Stilgar
turn_boundaries.text: I ask for this. Do not seek our sietches. Do not trespass in our lands. The desert was ours long before you came. So, come and dig your spice, but when you have it, go back to this side of the Shield Wall and leave the desert to the Fremen.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Gurney Halleck
turn_boundaries.text: You will address the Duke as "my lord" or "sire."

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duke Leto Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: Gurney, just... just a moment. The Emperor has given me Arrakis as my fief to rule and protect. I cannot promise not to travel into the desert if duty compels me. But your sietches will be yours forever. And you will never be hunted while I govern here.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Stilgar
turn_boundaries.text: That's very honourable. I must go. That's all I have to say to you.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duke Leto Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: Won't you stay? We would honour you.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Stilgar
turn_boundaries.text: Honour requires that I be elsewhere.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Gurney Halleck
turn_boundaries.text: I don't like him.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duncan Idaho
turn_boundaries.text: Our plan bears fruit.

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duke Leto Atreides
turn_boundaries.text: But it will take time?

turn_boundaries.speaker: Duncan Idaho
turn_boundaries.text: Yes. It will take time.
